question: Which displayed weapons.json numeric field families still require source extraction after excluding generated families and existing field-level reviews?

assumptions.text: Mixed 1.4.2.5 export, Sym fields, panel evidence and reviewed 1.4.3.0 changes. A source label is not field-level verification.

sourceFacts.reviewReuse: Earlier release evidence retains Head 4892017 and descriptor 91c9ea7c3dd830e34a78123c8bb7485e80eefdb18fc9c7ee41117971d23565c2. The 126 GS/WB and 43 base-projectile assets used to exclude existing reviews were independently hash-compared with current raw: all 169 match. This is carry-forward by raw hash, not 169 new field measurements.

censusConclusion: No qualified family remains after existing field-level reviews, non-displayed metadata and unused literals are excluded. The external census is not promoted into site data. No Stage 2 source-extraction worker was launched; no new per-family comparison receipt is implied.

reviewReuse.currentSiteAgainstEarlierLeafLedger: All current numeric leaves have a prior ledger entry. The 34 changed values are covered by 32 applied L107 precision rows and two later burst-cadence values. The damage pairs are unchanged for all 63 exact site identities.
reviewReuse.sourceReviewDetailHashes: All five sampled family-wide detail files match their receipt hashes; exact values/paths/offsets remain in those original receipts and details.
reviewReuse.knownPrecision: L107 retains 10 sub-f32 rows (RPM 5, tactical reload 3, empty reload 1, DB-12 bursts/minute 1) and 55 reviewed derived recoilV aliases (38 sub-f32, 17 held beyond-f32). These are prior reviewed decisions, not new proposals.
reviewReuse.intentionalDamageDeviation: The M45A1 54–75 m ramp is retained as a step in the site, under the 13 September damage/BTK review. At 60 m the site keeps 14.3 versus the serialized curve about 13.7857. Reuse frosty-site-projectile-2026-09-23.json; no new mismatch proposal.
reviewReuse.knownEmptyReloadDeviation: SOR-300SC 3.2 s and GRT-CPS 3.034 s follow reviewed in-game phase/timing evidence rather than the conflicting 3.284 s ReloadTime field. ATTACHMENT_BUGS.md item 15 and L123 explain the retained totals.
reviewReuse.handlingScope: No numeric ADS/deploy/sprint base indices occur in weapons.json. They live in balance_tables.json. Historical measured ADS milliseconds inside provenance are metadata.
reviewReuse.routeLimits: No new family route was required after the census exclusions. Mode-selection interpretation belongs to the parallel L600+ session.

inference: Raw-byte identity preserves the earlier decoded serialized values for the excluded reviews. This does not establish native execution, attachment composition or a global unchanged-game result.
unresolved: Existing native-runtime and model limits in the cited reviews remain. The census does not replace the separate fire-mode session or re-open accepted/declined precision decisions.
siteImpact: No new class (a) proposal. No site data, simulation or UI edit. No generator rerun or in-game test.

commands.note: Executed by absolute script path from the site checkout; the script records the exact prior-work subprocess argv and cwd.

leads.title: Weapons site audit census
leads.summary: Existing field-level reviews carry forward by raw hash; no displayed weapons.json family qualifies for new extraction after the requested exclusions.
leads.reopenWhen: A displayed numeric leaf changes without a reviewed receipt, or a cited source asset changes.

assets.question: Does the current known-answer base velocity reproduce the reviewed operand?
assets.conclusion: M433 base InitialSpeed.z remains 630 at offset 416; raw hash matches release evidence.
